title: AVI files written by Movie Maker (MJPEG MovieWriter) have an incorrect RIFF chunk size in the header
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.stable (and all earlier versions — the bug has existed since `MovieWriter` was first implemented in commit 5786516, which shipped in 4.0.stable)

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.7.5) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M2 Max (Apple8) - Apple M2 Max (12 threads) - 64.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When recording with Movie Maker (`MovieWriterMJPEG`, the `.avi` writer), the **RIFF chunk size** stored in the AVI header is wrong. The size field is 70 bytes smaller than it should be, so the header claims the file is smaller than it actually is.

The RIFF chunk size field (4 bytes at file offset `0x04`) must contain `total_file_size - 8`, i.e. it covers everything after the leading `"RIFF"` FourCC (4 bytes) and the size field itself (4 bytes). Instead, the writer stores `total_file_size - 78`.

This can be confirmed with `exiftool`:

```
$ exiftool -validate -warning movie.avi
Validate                        : 1 Warning
Warning                         : Incorrect RIFF chunk size 16022 vs. 15952
```

The actual file is `16022` bytes, but the RIFF header declares a total of `15952` bytes (70 bytes short).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the attached minimal reproduction project (it sets `editor/movie_writer/movie_file` to `./movie.avi`, and the main scene calls `get_tree().quit()` on `_ready()` so it records a single frame).
2. Run the project with Movie Maker enabled (`Run → enable Movie Maker Mode`, or run with `--write-movie movie.avi`).
3. Open the produced `movie.avi` and check its RIFF chunk size, e.g. `exiftool -validate -warning movie.avi`.
4. Observe the warning `Incorrect RIFF chunk size <file_size> vs. <file_size - 70>`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[movie-maker-invalid-riff-size-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29237979/movie-maker-invalid-riff-size-mrp.zip)
